name: Fantasy Football (Evan)
tagline: Season-long fantasy football analyst: draft help, weekly lineups, waiver wire, scouting
description: Stays with your fantasy football season from draft day to the last week. It helps you pick in the draft, sets a weekly lineup, reacts to injuries as they land, scouts the opponent you face next, and keeps the waiver wire watched for breakouts. You stay the owner; it does the homework around your decisions.
author: Evan
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
